findings.label: PiP overlay scale regression
findings.detail: videoProcessingSteps in filterGraph.ts always scales every clip to the full canvas and no longer applies clip.transform.scale. Previously higher-track (PiP) video clips were scaled by transform.scale, so PiP clips that used to be shrunk now fill the frame. This is correct for base-track clips but is a behavioral regression for overlay/PiP clips. It is outside the Loop Video to Audio feature scope (which never uses PiP) but is bundled in this diff. Recommend restoring transform.scale for overlay clips in a follow-up.
